defaults.implementation_reason: Performance execution remains disabled until the native worker and synchronized endpoint metric window pass their readiness receipts.

scenarios.implementation_reason: Requires a calibrated repeated-sample runner, warm-up policy and baseline comparison; correctness timing_ms is not a performance percentile.
Requires a sustained bounded transfer generator and endpoint byte-rate counters; the correctness client sends only finite validation payloads.
Requires synchronized local ProxyBridge/driver CPU sampling around an isolated workload; server endpoint CPU metrics alone cannot attribute product cost.
Requires synchronized product working-set/private-byte sampling and a baseline window; current server metrics cover only the remote endpoint service.
Requires privileged local process handle counters before, during and after a workload with leak thresholds; no such product sampler is implemented.
Requires synchronized product thread-count sampling and post-run recovery thresholds; endpoint service metrics cannot substitute for product evidence.
Requires a rate-controlled connection generator and accepted-flow counter over a fixed interval; bounded correctness concurrency is not a flow-rate benchmark.
Requires a rate-controlled UDP generator, loss accounting and endpoint interval counters; finite datagram semantics tests do not measure datagrams per second.
